title: foot rest way too short
text:
foot rest way too short. Boy, am I disappointed. I am 5’3” and the foot rest only reaches my mid-calf when fully chair is fully reclined. The foot rest does not come all the way up, so it is not level with the seat. The back, when “fully reclined” barely moves back. I am sitting almost upright.
I was expecting to footrest to be long enough to fully support my short legs. I was expecting the back to recline to at least 135 deg. if not more.
I cannot recommend this chair for comfort - many ergonomic flaws
